coverage: Repo HEAD 8f5fe4aa (2026-09-29). FULL CENSUS (sampled=false): every rule in the 'review' (58 rules), 'close-out' (44), 'plan-review' (16) and 'implementation' (18) templates of lib/prompt-template-defs.js, counting only each template's own text; shared formatter sections they inline (formatReadOnlyWorkflow, formatAttachmentPerceptionCheck, formatPlanFidelityCheck, formatCiGateCheck, formatIfBlocked) are counted under 'formatters', not here. Also every rule in lib/prompts/autopilot-kickoff.js (77 rules), counting each rendering variant once (stepper, readonly/write, budgeted, scoped/general variants are included and tagged in the summary); standalone-only alternates of the same rules and the inlined handbook (docs/autopilot-operating-manual.md) are excluded. SYSTEMATIC SAMPLE (sampled=true): every rule in each source was enumerated in file order, and rules #1, #4, #7, ... were kept. Full enumerations are in parts/<source>.enum.txt. Populations and kept counts: plan 31 -> 11; research 26 -> 9; formatters 20 -> 7; passage-runner (body after the first '---' in docs/passage-runner-prompt.md) 35 -> 12; meta-prompt (the metaPrompt literal in lib/prompts/meta-prompt-template.js, conditional and flag-gated blocks included, quality-rule bullets split per numbered/lettered clause) 204 -> 68. The formatters population is appendGroundingSections' four sections, formatAttachmentsSection, formatCiGateCheck, formatPlanFidelityCheck, formatAttachmentPerceptionCheck, formatScaleToTask and formatIfBlocked; feature-flag-gated toggles are excluded. Population byte totals for the sampled sources, summed over all enumerated rules: plan 10915, research 8656, formatters 7361, passage-runner 11844, meta-prompt 96083. bytes = UTF-8 length of the rule's source text with JS quote wrappers, escapes, indentation and // comments stripped (scratchpad/build.py; tokens ~ bytes/4). Enforcement: runtime-code needs a runtime refusal, flag or deterministic performance. Metric and eval scripts (follow-on-ratio.js, plan-review-round-trips.js, scripts/eval-*) do not count. A tests/unit assertion that the text is present counts as prose-pinned-by-test, including weak anchor-word pins.

rules.summary: [stepper] Beat 1 fresh as ROOT; later beats followUpTo ROOT, force:true, same cli/web target, own sessionId
rules.incident: Omitting the wake edge starved beat 4 of its wake (LIN-1324)
rules.class_reason: Dispatch fields (followUpTo=ROOT, force, same target) are mechanically checkable; only the cli/web target is refused at runtime (lib/dispatch-validation.js:236).

rules.summary: [stepper] Set BOTH subscription:'everything' (wake) and waitForFollowUps:true (hold) on every beat
rules.incident: Without the hold the worker finalized after beat 1; cold --resume lost memory
rules.class_reason: A stepper beat missing either flag could be defaulted or refused at the dispatch seam; routes only type-check the booleans (routes/proxy-dispatch.js:293).

rules.summary: [stepper] After dispatching a beat, stop and stand by for the push; never build a long-poll watch
rules.incident: Hand-rolled long-poll caused beat-boundary deadlock and the LIN-831 wedge
rules.class_reason: Agent-side waiting behaviour; no seam can observe that an orchestrator is polling rather than idle. Restated in hard rules below.

rules.summary: [stepper] A beat woken as blocked is not a wedge: surface it to the human; exemption ends when unblocked
rules.incident: Old clause's premise (blocked beats stay silent) was false
rules.class_reason: Judgement about silence vs wedge; LIN-2332 replaced an earlier false clause, so this is a patch on the wedge rule.

rules.summary: [stepper] After ~30 min silence send one followUpTo ROOT liveness nudge, then re-dispatch; don't poll
rules.signature: still working? report where things stand
rules.class_reason: A fixed 30-minute silence ceiling is a timer the runner/dispatch store could fire itself instead of the orchestrator watching the clock.

rules.summary: [stepper] Judge and challenge each beat's recap; send a labelled corrective followUpTo before advancing
rules.class_reason: Judging whether tests are real and the plan was followed is model judgement no check makes.

rules.summary: [stepper] Do not one-shot the worker prompt or run the standard loop; run the beat loop instead
rules.class_reason: Selects which loop governs the run; framing a disposition, not checkable at a seam.

rules.summary: [stepper] Confirm a single task first; for a batch dispatch one stepper child autopilot per task, concurrently
rules.incident: Stepper stepped into the first task of a batch
rules.class_reason: Whether the goal names more than one task is detectable at kickoff build time; the server could refuse or route a multi-task stepper run.

rules.summary: [stepper] Hold a waits-on child until its blocker is judged clean; never close a DONE child; stalled child never blocks siblings
rules.incident: Serial child coordination stalled batches
rules.class_reason: Judging a blocker "clean" is judgement; the DONE-close half is already runner code (../simple-dispatcher/reapers.js:3410).

rules.summary: [stepper] Read the worker prompt via GET /recommend/{id}, not the fused dispatch verb
rules.class_reason: Procedural instruction on which read verb exposes the body; low cost, no violation mode worth code.

rules.summary: [stepper] Decompose into 3–6 ordered beats of ONE kind; never chain into review
rules.class_reason: Beat count bound (3–6) and single-kind constraint are countable from beat labels/kinds at the dispatch seam.

rules.summary: [stepper] Treat a mid-chain PENDING wake as a clean advance, not a fault
rules.class_reason: Interpretive guidance on a signal; nothing to enforce.

rules.summary: [stepper] Before concluding, post a run-summary comment: beats run, evidence, what holds, what's left
rules.class_reason: Presence of a run-summary comment at run end is mechanically checkable (a completion check on the orchestrator row).

rules.summary: [stepper] Warm single session is default; fresh-per-beat only as emergency fallback
rules.incident: Fresh-per-beat lost memory and paid re-orientation every beat
rules.class_reason: Whether later beats carry followUpTo=ROOT is visible on dispatch rows; largely restates beat 3 (self-duplicate).

rules.summary: [stepper] Label every send 'beat N/M: <label>', including corrective follow-ups
rules.incident: Run 2 left default "Prompt" labels, breaking progress tracking
rules.class_reason: Label format is a regex; the dispatch seam could reject or auto-label stepper beats.

rules.summary: [stepper] Reference files by repo-relative paths in beat prompts; worker checks its own pwd
rules.incident: Absolute path from orchestrator's clone sent worker down wrong tree, wedging beat
rules.class_reason: Absolute paths in a beat prompt are lint-detectable at dispatch (a regex on the prompt body).

rules.summary: [stepper] Hard rule: followUpTo always ROOT; force, subscription, waitForFollowUps on every beat
rules.class_reason: Verbatim restatement of beat step 3 within the same prompt.

rules.summary: [stepper] Hard rule: stand by for the push; never long-poll or idle on PENDING
rules.class_reason: Restates beat step 4 within the same prompt.

rules.summary: Orchestrator does not write code or hold its details; the worker does
rules.class_reason: Role/altitude disposition; not observable at a seam.

rules.summary: Read the handbook first; run the machinery through its lens
rules.class_reason: The handbook is composed inline directly above; "read it first" adds nothing a model would not do.

rules.summary: Human owns 'worth it' and 'done'; never redefine goals or ticket intent; flag value/direction decisions
rules.class_reason: Which decisions are value/direction is judgement.

rules.summary: Treat 'done' as a claim until you fetch proof: commit, PR, green CI, state change, evidence URLs
rules.class_reason: Core disposition; the fetch itself is agent behaviour (Harbour does post [evidence] URLs, but nothing checks the orchestrator read them).

rules.summary: Narrate freely; never touch the north star or a definition of done
rules.class_reason: Orchestrator writes to north-star/definition-of-done fields could be refused by token scope at the proxy.

rules.summary: Hold the task header, not the task; pull full prompt or feedback only when a decision needs it
rules.class_reason: Context-economy judgement.

rules.summary: Dispatch is mandate for reversible work; never hold a call waiting for a live reply outside the four lines
rules.incident: Orchestrators stalled waiting for a human go-ahead that never came
rules.class_reason: Anti-stall disposition; restated in proxy preamble for every dispatch.

rules.summary: Merge and Done need a recorded independent review Approve plus discharged/empty ledger, verified on the issue
rules.incident: Token/dispatch conflated with authorization to merge
rules.class_reason: No code gates merge on a recorded Approve (no merge verb exists in routes/); a merge-gate check on the verdict+ledger comments is mechanically possible.

rules.summary: Unprovable ledger items discharge via review's named monitor/rollback; risky undischarged items need a human naming the precondition
rules.incident: Blanket "human sign-off for risky merges" clause contradicted other surfaces
rules.class_reason: Restates the review/close-out proportional lane (LIN-1579 amends LIN-1365); close-out applies it, the orchestrator never does.

rules.summary: The proxy token authenticates the channel; it is not permission to merge
rules.class_reason: Restates the preceding "not authorization for the irreversible finish" sentence.

rules.summary: Human watches asynchronously; don't hold for confirmation — check against the four lines and flag in one line
rules.incident: Holds for confirmation hung until the run was reaped
rules.class_reason: Disposition against over-halting; judgement.

rules.summary: Use the supplied readWrite proxy token for every proxy call, including dispatched worker prompts
rules.class_reason: Every proxy call already fails 401 without a valid token (authenticateProxyToken), so the rule is self-enforcing.

rules.summary: Drill into a task's full detail via GET /brief only after picking it
rules.class_reason: Restated in the general first-act block ("Pull a task's full detail ... only once you've picked it").

rules.summary: Plain POST /dispatch only for human-supplied prompts; resume sessions via followUpTo on recommend-and-dispatch
rules.class_reason: Whether a plain /dispatch carries a human-authored prompt vs orchestrator-authored is detectable by caller token kind; could be refused.

rules.summary: Pass your session id as sessionId on every worker dispatch, recommend-and-dispatch, and followUpTo nudge
rules.incident: Spawned work did not group into one session
rules.class_reason: The server knows the caller is an autopilot dispatch (appendAutopilotSessionRef); it could stamp sessionId itself instead of asking.

rules.summary: Pick next by policy: explicit human goal, else top of stack; say what you picked in a line
rules.class_reason: Two-level order is explicitly superseded by the general first-act three-level order (LIN-1829) and moot in scoped runs; it never governs a run.

rules.summary: Re-read the handbook via GET /autopilot/manual at the top of each loop
rules.incident: Orchestrator lost altitude on long runs
rules.class_reason: Self-refresh habit; unobservable except as a GET count.

rules.summary: Trigger steps via POST /recommend-and-dispatch with sessionId; never read or hold the prompt body
rules.class_reason: The fused verb already hides the body server-side, so compliance is structural; wording is guidance on which verb to use.

rules.summary: Read kind sequence as health: research→plan→impl→review→close-out converging; same kind repeating is looping
rules.class_reason: Kind sequence per task is in dispatch history; a loop detector could flag repeats instead of the orchestrator eyeballing it.

rules.summary: One plan→plan-review→plan round trip is converging; a second is looping — escalate, never run a third
rules.incident: Plan-review loops burned 4+ sessions with zero commits
rules.class_reason: Round-trip count is computed by lib/plan-review-round-trips.js (measurement only; 33/94 tickets exceeded one cycle); a dispatch refusal could enforce it.

rules.summary: If recommend-and-dispatch times out or errors, halt; never hand-write your own prompt
rules.class_reason: Halt disposition; overlaps the halt paragraph below.

rules.summary: On a clearly wrong verb, pin it via kind on recommend-and-dispatch and note why; never hand-write the prompt
rules.class_reason: Recognising a wrong verb is judgement; the kind override itself is recorded by code.

rules.summary: After dispatching, stop and stand by for the push wake; never poll or build a watch loop
rules.incident: Old long-poll watch loop kept orchestrator busy so wakes could not land
rules.class_reason: Agent waiting behaviour not observable at a seam; the old long-poll rule was removed (1403655c/5fc2bdd7).

rules.summary: A step woken as blocked is not a wedge; surface it to the human; exemption lasts only while blocked
rules.incident: Earlier clause wrongly claimed blocked steps stay silent
rules.class_reason: Judgement on silence; LIN-2332 replaced a false premise (patch on the wedge rule).

rules.summary: After ~30 min silence send a one-line liveness followUpTo nudge; if it can't resume, re-dispatch or hand back
rules.incident: Silent workers wedged runs indefinitely
rules.signature: still working? report where things stand
rules.class_reason: A 30-minute zero-activity timer is mechanical; the runner or dispatch store could emit the nudge or a wedged wake.

rules.summary: Read worker's last lines; a done that is still waiting is not-yet — confirm CI/substitute before advancing
rules.incident: Workers exited done while CI still running
rules.signature: confirm CI went green and report the run URL
rules.class_reason: Reading whether closing words mean waiting is judgement.

rules.summary: On done, fetch evidence URLs; confirm the kind's real deliverable changed, else flag 'claimed, not verified'
rules.class_reason: Per-kind deliverable existence (commit/PR/plan in description/state change) is largely checkable; completion-signal code could verify rather than the orchestrator.

rules.summary: Hand heavy cross-check reading (CI traces, diffs, logs) to a sub-agent; ask for verdict plus evidence
rules.class_reason: Context-management judgement.

rules.summary: After each step, give the human a short line and decide continue/complete/pause; continue is common
rules.class_reason: Decision judgement.

rules.summary: On complete: scoped run stops; never close DONE sessions or abort child autopilots — the runner reaps them
rules.incident: Autopilot closed windows itself; replaced by runner close-on-DONE
rules.class_reason: Runner already closes DONE windows (../simple-dispatcher/reapers.js:3410); rule only forbids a now-obsolete act. LIN-1206 reverses LIN-1071.

rules.summary: Pause for the human on direction questions, risky changes, uncleared blockers, sprawl, contradicting evidence; use handbook hand-back
rules.class_reason: Pointer to handbook; which moments are the human's is judgement.

rules.summary: Merge/close are not the orchestrator's; close-out owns merge, Done, summary, archive/prune, follow-ups
rules.class_reason: Nothing in code stops the orchestrator merging (no merge seam in routes/); restates close-out prune rules on every run, trivial or not.

rules.summary: On Approve, dispatch close-out via recommend-and-dispatch, then verify PR merged, CI green on landed commit, task Done
rules.class_reason: Routing to close-out is done by the engine; verification of the finish is orchestrator judgement.

rules.summary: On conditional Approve let close-out discharge the ledger; don't judge it informally; close-out authors only trivial named edits
rules.class_reason: Restates close-out's own authoring bound (LIN-3033 amends LIN-804 wording); the orchestrator never performs it.

rules.summary: Finish lines are only task verified complete or a human-review point; extra settle pass is normal
rules.class_reason: Stopping judgement.

rules.summary: [budgeted] Run covers up to N distinct tasks; on 409 BUDGET_EXHAUSTED wind down and report
rules.class_reason: Server refuses the NEW-task dispatch; restated three times (snapshot, finish line, instruments).

rules.summary: [budgeted] Any one task may take at most N worker sessions, enforced server-side
rules.class_reason: Server-enforced; restated three times in the same prompt.

rules.summary: At run end close nothing: no cascade or reaper; just stop and report
rules.incident: End-of-run close --cascade removed when runner took over DONE close
rules.class_reason: Runner owns DONE close (../simple-dispatcher/reapers.js:3410); rule survives only to countermand the removed cascade instruction.

rules.summary: Treat terminal done as 'go look', never proof; a done waiting on CI/deploy ended mid-flight
rules.incident: Workers backgrounded commands and posted done before work landed
rules.class_reason: Restates cross-check step 4 almost verbatim in the same prompt.

rules.summary: A [stalled?] with last tool Bash is usually a long command; check before re-dispatching
rules.class_reason: Known-quirk fact; cheap and useful.

rules.summary: wait=50 is a one-off liveness check, never a standing watch loop; 30-min ceiling applies
rules.class_reason: Restates step 3 stand-by and 30-minute rules.

rules.summary: In shell loops never name the variable status (zsh read-only)
rules.incident: zsh reserved $status aborted poll-loop assignment
rules.class_reason: Only mattered for the removed poll loop; the prompt now forbids poll loops.

rules.summary: Don't set a short client timeout on /recommend; it can run past 25s
rules.class_reason: Instrument fact; cheap.

rules.summary: On 409 DUPLICATE_DISPATCH adopt the returned id and stand by; never retry, reword, count a strike, or halt
rules.incident: Two sessions doing the same work
rules.class_reason: Server refuses the duplicate; the prose only prevents the orchestrator misreading the 409 as a failure.

rules.summary: [budgeted] On 409 task budget: wind down, comment naming bound and ledger, post summary, stop
rules.class_reason: Refusal is runtime; the wind-down comment is agent behaviour.

rules.summary: [budgeted] On 409 per-task session budget: comment naming bound and ledger, post summary, stop
rules.class_reason: Refusal is runtime; the report is agent behaviour.

rules.summary: Space requests under 60/min rate limit
rules.class_reason: express-rate-limit enforces 60/min; the prompt now forbids polling anyway.

rules.summary: On network error, timeout, 5xx, or unparseable response: halt, say what failed, wait; never improvise
rules.class_reason: Distinguishing breakage from known quirks is judgement.

rules.summary: Every turn restate to yourself role, next allowed action, task header, strike counters
rules.class_reason: Internal self-talk; unobservable.

rules.summary: Narrate to the human one line per loop boundary
rules.class_reason: Narration habit; format could be linted but lines are free text.

rules.summary: [readonly] Don't use recommend-and-dispatch; hand-author investigation prompts via POST /dispatch forbidding code/PR/state changes
rules.signature: no code changes, no PRs, no tracker state changes
rules.class_reason: Read-only is an admitted convention, not enforced; the proxy could refuse writes and the fused verb for a readonly-run token.

rules.summary: [write] Drive through close via close-out, never merge inline; pause before large or risky changes land
rules.class_reason: Restates the finish-line section in the same prompt.

rules.summary: [budgeted] State task budget up front; wind down and post summary as you approach it
rules.class_reason: Server enforces; third restatement of the task budget in the same prompt.

rules.summary: [budgeted] Per-task session budget stated up front; plan pace per task
rules.class_reason: Server enforces; restated in finish line and instruments.

rules.summary: [scoped] Loop only on the pinned task until complete or a human point; never pull other tasks off the stack
rules.class_reason: A scoped run could be refused dispatches for other issueIdentifiers (maxTasks=1-style guard) instead of asking.

rules.summary: [scoped] First read the brief (and raw issue), then trigger recommend-and-dispatch and go; dispatch is the go-ahead
rules.class_reason: Opening procedure; low-risk guidance.

rules.summary: [general] Check periodicals first, per repo lane; precedence is goal > due periodical > top of stack
rules.incident: Aggregated periodical state hid which repo was overdue
rules.class_reason: A fixed precedence policy ("not a judgment call") over computed state; the stack endpoint could rank due periodicals itself. Amends the Orient rule.

rules.summary: [general] Stamp periodicalId only on the chain-opening recommend-and-dispatch; never on followUpTo beats
rules.incident: Cadence ledger could not see periodical runs
rules.class_reason: Later stamps are already ignored in code (lib/periodical-runs.js:134); the server could stamp the opening call from the chosen periodical.

rules.summary: [general] Fetch stack digest, orient under policy, announce choice; pull full detail only once picked
rules.class_reason: Opening procedure.

rules.summary: Read the review verdict and the gaps it flagged as not covered by CI.
rules.incident: Heading-keyed ledger gate caused a review/close-out loop
rules.class_reason: Reads substance fuzzily by design (LIN-810).

rules.summary: Do not proceed past the gate until the ledger is satisfied; everything after is irreversible.
rules.class_reason: Restated by the Ledger Gate section and the All-Clear condition in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Merge only after the gate passes, re-checking CI (or substitute) on a fresh read of the exact commit.
rules.class_reason: A merge wrapper using --match-head-commit plus a checks query refuses a stale or red head.

rules.summary: Verify on the landed commit and set Done in-session; no "confirm it works" follow-up.
rules.class_reason: Restated in full by "Close the bookkeeping here" and All-Clear item 2.

rules.summary: Summary comment: what merged, how each ledger item was discharged or accepted, and final CI state.
rules.class_reason: Summary must carry one line per ledger item plus CI state: structurally checkable.

rules.summary: Archive a pre-prune snapshot, then prune superseded stage-artifact sections.
rules.class_reason: Restated as All-Clear item 4 and the Archive & Prune section.

rules.summary: File remaining outside follow-ups, routed, linked, with priority and type label, after checking none exists.
rules.class_reason: Summary of All-Clear item 5 and Follow-up Triage in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Don't re-review; author a change only if review named its exact content and it is trivial, else hold and route.
rules.incident: Close-out merged content review never saw
rules.class_reason: LIN-3033 amends LIN-2825/550; "review-named" is judgement, size half is mechanical (see hunk bound).

rules.summary: Never merge or set Done while any ledger item is undischarged; route depends on inside/outside mark.
rules.incident: Irreversible finish had no owner or gate
rules.class_reason: Central gate is prose-only: proxy could refuse Done absent a recorded Approve; per-item discharge stays judgement.

rules.summary: Inside item discharges only by cited done-evidence or a justified explicit drop; filing never discharges; no Done otherwise.
rules.incident: Inside-scope work was discharged by filing follow-up tickets
rules.class_reason: LIN-3006 amends LIN-2825 (materiality bar); evidence quality is judgement.

rules.summary: Self-authored discharge must quote review verbatim, be at most 2 files/3 hunks, add no tests or logic, and re-run CI.
rules.incident: Close-out merged content review never saw
rules.class_reason: File, hunk and line counts plus "no test file touched" are a git diff --numstat check.

rules.summary: Outside item discharges by a follow-up ticket that stands alone for a reader without this task.
rules.class_reason: Self-sufficiency of a ticket is judgement.

rules.summary: Any item may be explicitly accepted by a human who names the exact precondition exercised.
rules.class_reason: Judging a named precondition is judgement.

rules.summary: Green CI never discharges a ledger item; a human "validated" without a named precondition does not either.
rules.class_reason: Floor on evidence quality; judgement.

rules.summary: Low-risk prompt/docs change: routing to post-merge observation is itself the discharge, citing review's name.
rules.incident: Prompt-wording change required human sign-off for unprovable claims
rules.class_reason: LIN-1579/LIN-2917 amend LIN-898; the named-monitor/rollback routes below re-scope this lane.

rules.summary: Accept a named monitor from review; a ticket is not a monitor; reject entries lacking review's justification line.
rules.incident: 31 of 50 ticket-as-monitor discharges were never worked
rules.class_reason: Presence of a named monitor and review's justification line are fields a ledger lint could require.

rules.summary: Accept a named rollback (revert commit or flag value) meeting the reversibility conditions.
rules.class_reason: Reversibility judgement.

rules.summary: Unnamed monitor or rollback does not get the lane; never supply names; floors unchanged.
rules.class_reason: Restates the two named-route bullets above and the green-CI floor stated earlier in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Recorded Approve plus discharged ledger is authorization; no fresh human go-ahead; no verdict means route to review.
rules.incident: Autopilot held at merge gate despite an Approve the day before
rules.class_reason: LIN-1365 amends LIN-810 amends LIN-550; authority framing is disposition.

rules.summary: An explicitly empty ledger is a no-op pass-through; don't manufacture doubt.
rules.class_reason: Anti-overreach disposition.

rules.summary: Perform the irreversible set only when every item is discharged and CI is green on the exact commit.
rules.class_reason: Restates workflow steps 3-4 and the Ledger Gate in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Merge; any conflict resolution is authoring, never review-named: hold the merge and route to implementation.
rules.incident: Close-out merged content review never saw
rules.class_reason: Whether landing needed conflict resolution is mechanically detectable from the merge.

rules.summary: Verify on the landed commit, then set Done.
rules.class_reason: Restates workflow step 5.

rules.summary: Post the summary comment: merged, ledger resolution, final CI state.
rules.class_reason: Restates workflow step 6.

rules.summary: Archive a pre-prune snapshot, then prune stage artifacts.
rules.class_reason: Restates workflow step 7.

rules.summary: File remaining outside follow-ups, routed, linked, with priority and type label.
rules.class_reason: Restates workflow step 8.

rules.summary: Close bookkeeping on merge; elapsed-time claims go to a named monitor, never an open task or follow-up.
rules.class_reason: Judgement of what needs elapsed time.

rules.summary: When the gate cannot pass, hold the merge, leave open, and name the next action kind.
rules.class_reason: Routing judgement.

rules.summary: Only outside items may be filed; dropped or undischarged inside items are never filed; "file" only for outside.
rules.class_reason: Restates the Ledger Gate clause; a rulings/issue-create field for the inside mark would make it refusable.

rules.summary: A close-out-raised "do it here" ruling is never review-named: hold the merge, route to implementation.
rules.incident: Close-out merged content review never saw
rules.class_reason: Already covered by the Role's list and "Always name a next action" in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Every filed follow-up carries a priority and a type label, never provider default.
rules.incident: Close-out follow-ups landed untriaged (27/30 in one wave)
rules.class_reason: Issue-create from a close-out dispatch could require priority and label.

rules.summary: Before filing, search relations and search for an existing ticket; link instead of refiling.
rules.class_reason: Matching the same finding is judgement.

rules.summary: Before raising a DECISION, check rulings incl. resolved; never re-raise a covered finding.
rules.class_reason: Rulings route holds the data to refuse a duplicate DECISION on the same anchor.

rules.summary: Derive priority from the finding's risk, state why in one line, set via priorityLevel (4 = highest).
rules.incident: Native descending scale would file urgent follow-ups as Low
rules.class_reason: Risk judgement; the scale half is already fixed by the API field.

rules.summary: Type label from the workspace label catalog, never invented; say so if none fits.
rules.incident: Close-out follow-ups landed untriaged (27/30 in one wave)
rules.class_reason: Issue-create could validate the label against the catalog.

rules.summary: Priority/label is best-effort: if a provider drops it, note it; never retry or fail the close.
rules.class_reason: Fallback disposition.

rules.summary: Archive & prune only after merge and Done on the all-clear path, never on a cannot-close branch.
rules.class_reason: Precondition is a state check (Done + merged) the description-write route could enforce.

rules.summary: Before editing the description, call brief?noRefresh=1 to capture the pre-prune snapshot.
rules.class_reason: The description PATCH route could snapshot before every write, removing the step.

rules.summary: Confirm via snapshots that the archive landed before pruning.
rules.incident: Archive call is fire-and-forget and swallows its errors
rules.class_reason: Same: server-side snapshot-before-write makes verification unnecessary.

rules.summary: If the snapshot cannot be verified, skip the prune, record it, and still close the task.
rules.incident: Archive step had no fallback once merge and Done had landed
rules.class_reason: Patch on LIN-1770 that disappears if the server snapshots before writes.

rules.summary: Prune via PATCH: replace plan/research/scoping sections with a stub naming work, PR, deviations, history.
rules.class_reason: What is superseded is judgement.

rules.summary: Never prune problem statement, acceptance criteria, repro steps, scope, or referenced sections.
rules.class_reason: Section identification is judgement.

rules.summary: The stub must keep "fits one session"/"needs multiple sessions" or an "Implementation Plan" heading verbatim.
rules.incident: Deterministic readers break when the literals are pruned
rules.class_reason: Description PATCH could refuse a write that drops these literals.

rules.summary: The prune edits the description only; comments are untouched.
rules.class_reason: Low cost clarification; nothing to check.

rules.summary: Determine once, boundedly, whether CI exists (config + one settle); never arm a Monitor on unobserved checks.
rules.incident: Monitor armed on a nonexistent check set: 195-minute stall (LIN-1358 wedge).
rules.class_reason: CI presence is mechanically detectable (workflow files, statusCheckRollup); the server or runner could determine and inject it once.

rules.summary: Treat the ticket as a hypothesis; git log referenced paths since creation and re-read changed source at HEAD.
rules.incident: Ticket descriptions invalidated by later commits were trusted as ground truth.
rules.class_reason: Reconciling ticket prose with current code is judgement; the git-log half could be precomputed but the rule is appended once, deterministically.

rules.summary: When attachments exist, fetch and actually perceive every one, including images, before any grounding claim.
rules.incident: Worker claimed grounding on three of four attachments, skipping an image.
rules.class_reason: Actual perception cannot be checked; already self-gated to tasks with attachments. The enumerate-by-id sibling is checkable.

rules.summary: A terminal task with no open subtasks: do not redo it; verify, capture missing follow-ups, close out.
rules.incident: Container-descent bug: recommender redid finished tasks as if unstarted.
rules.class_reason: Already code-gated to render only on terminal tasks, so it costs nothing on ordinary dispatches.

rules.summary: Leave the bug label in place once fixed; Done marks resolution, label is the lasting bug record.
rules.incident: Prompts removed the bug label on fix, losing bug-vs-feature reporting.
rules.class_reason: Removing a named label is a write the proxy label seam could refuse; restated three times across paths.

rules.summary: Match output depth to the task's actual scale; small single-surface tasks get a short result.
rules.incident: Small tasks received template-sized output.
rules.class_reason: Judging a task's true scale is model judgement (eval-prompt-scaling.mjs measured it, not enforces it).

rules.summary: Before parking BLOCKED, try local resolution; orchestrator-owned gaps are PENDING-EXTERNAL, not BLOCKED.
rules.incident: Workers parked BLOCKED on things only the orchestrator needed to supply.
rules.class_reason: Whether a gap genuinely needs a person is judgement (lib/escalation-kpis.js only measures it).

rules.summary: Set the issue status to "In Progress" at start if not already.
rules.class_reason: A status transition the dispatch seam could perform itself when an implementation dispatch starts.

rules.summary: Work on a feature branch; never commit straight to main.
rules.incident: Commit, PR, CI, merge, close lifecycle had no clear owner
rules.class_reason: Branch protection or a pre-push check enforces this mechanically.

rules.summary: Commit with a message referencing the issue identifier, then push the branch.
rules.incident: Commit, PR, CI, merge, close lifecycle had no clear owner
rules.class_reason: Commit-message lint for the identifier.

rules.summary: Open a PR targeting main that references the identifier; the PR is the deliverable.
rules.incident: Commit, PR, CI, merge, close lifecycle had no clear owner
rules.class_reason: PR existence is queryable; a completion check could require it.

rules.summary: Done only when PR open and CI green (or substitute recorded); otherwise say why; never merge yourself.
rules.incident: Review owned both sides of the merge boundary
rules.class_reason: CI state on the PR head is queryable; the no-merge half could be a token scope.

rules.summary: Add a summary comment with the PR link.
rules.class_reason: Presence of a PR URL in the final comment is checkable.

rules.summary: Implement only within the defined scope; flag scope expansion for approval instead of absorbing it.
rules.class_reason: Scope judgement.

rules.summary: Confirm the plan's files and surfaces still exist; if drifted, stop and recommend re-planning.
rules.class_reason: File existence is mechanical but surface mapping is judgement.

rules.summary: Follow plan and research; where they disagree the research's reasoning wins; flag the conflict.
rules.incident: Implementer blindly trusted a lossy plan over its research
rules.class_reason: Restates formatPlanFidelityCheck's closing sentence, inlined just above in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Make each change self-contained, specifying behaviour and its cleanup/teardown contract.
rules.class_reason: Design judgement.

rules.summary: For a first-time dependency, verify all required setup beyond API calls.
rules.class_reason: Judgement; already conditional on a new dependency.

rules.summary: Write tests for new or changed behaviour, covering plan-flagged interactions.
rules.class_reason: Which behaviours need tests is judgement.

rules.summary: Verify all tests pass before completing.
rules.class_reason: Superseded by workflow step 8 and the CI-gate section, which require green CI.

rules.summary: Observe your acceptance-witness test fail against unfixed code (or a mutation) before trusting it; record what you saw.
rules.incident: Implementation asked for green, never for red
rules.class_reason: Running the red check could be automated, but choosing the witness is judgement.

rules.summary: Keep changes minimal and focused on the task.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Distrust "behaviour-preserving" labels: enumerate old behaviours and verify each, ideally with a characterization test.
rules.class_reason: Enumerating behaviours is judgement.

rules.summary: Keep behaviours converging on shared code isolated; document non-obvious interactions in comments.
rules.class_reason: Design judgement.

rules.summary: Plan-flagged cross-cutting concerns must appear in the relevant implementation step, not be deferred to review.
rules.class_reason: Judgement of placement.

rules.summary: Use the deterministic frontier facts for the defer-vs-breakdown decision instead of re-counting children.
rules.incident: Model re-derived child counts at the defer-vs-breakdown fork.
rules.class_reason: Facts are already computed in code (lib/recommendation-facts.js); the remaining healthy-container call is judgement.

rules.summary: When the ticket lacks a detail, tell the consumer to find it in the codebase, never supply it.
rules.incident: Generated prompts invented paths, schemas and specifics absent from the ticket.
rules.class_reason: Spotting invented specifics in generated prose needs judgement; no reliable lint exists.

rules.summary: Multi-surface, cross-cutting, migration or uncertain tasks get the full prompt structure.
rules.incident: Prompts were sized to the template rather than the task.
rules.class_reason: Scale judgement; mirrored by formatScaleToTask on the handwritten path.

rules.summary: Recommend exactly one action, following the decision tree in order.
rules.class_reason: parseRecommendedAction already takes a single `→ **action**`; a strict one-arrow check would retire this and its restatements (L339-340).

rules.summary: Terminal task with open children: do not short-circuit to review/close; descend to the open child.
rules.incident: Container-descent bug: terminal parent short-circuited despite open children.
rules.class_reason: The condition is computed in code (isTerminal && hasOpenChildren); routing to the frontier child could be deterministic.

rules.summary: Reviewed, merged and Done work routes to retrospective-audit, never another review or close-out.
rules.incident: Retrospective sweep had to borrow pre-merge review for already-merged work.
rules.class_reason: Done state is machine-readable but spotting a recorded review verdict in the trail is reading, not a check.

rules.summary: A plan-review verdict is never review evidence for close-out, header or not.
rules.incident: A plan-review Approve could authorize close-out on unimplemented work.
rules.class_reason: Which kind posted a verdict is in dispatch history; tagging it in code would replace this; restated verbatim at L194.

rules.summary: Route to research when doing the deliverable well depends on knowledge not yet gathered.
rules.class_reason: Whether needed knowledge is in hand is a judgement no check can make.

rules.summary: Apply the core test using signals: external sources, unpinned dependencies, hedged wording, surfaces named only by description.
rules.incident: Research under-fired on 'everywhere'/consistency tickets.
rules.class_reason: Heuristic cue list feeding a judgement call.

rules.summary: Do not loop research when findings and a validated approach exist, including approved breakdown-child plan slices.
rules.incident: Breakdown children of an approved plan were re-routed to research.
rules.class_reason: Core call is judgement; only the breakdown-child sub-clause keys on a checkable literal line (LIN-3049 amends the LIN-1603 gate).

rules.summary: If the substance is in hand and the approach validated, skip to Step 2.
rules.class_reason: Arrow summary restating Step 1's core test and over-fire guards in the same prompt.

rules.summary: If blocked, first check whether blocking dependencies are already resolved before full analysis.
rules.class_reason: Blocker resolution is a relation-plus-state lookup the recommender could precompute like frontier facts; restated in the Blocked-prompts rule.

rules.summary: Re-investigate only if findings are missing, contradicted or unvalidated; fix only on a confirmed standing root cause.
rules.incident: A fix advanced on a root cause a later comment had refuted.
rules.class_reason: Whether a cause still stands at the end of the trail needs reading; mirrored in formatBugInvestigatedNote.

rules.summary: Landed work with red CI or a surfaced blocker routes to that blocker, not implementation or review.
rules.incident: Landed work with red CI kept cycling through review.
rules.class_reason: CI red is machine-readable but the coordinator cannot see CI (L192); feeding CI status would replace inference. Overlaps Step 0 L149.

rules.summary: Close-out requires positive evidence a review ran; a complete-looking description is not evidence.
rules.incident: Close-out recommended on a complete-looking description with no review.
rules.class_reason: Verbatim repeat of the Step 0 sentence at L147 in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Only an actual review verdict authorizes close-out; with none or ambiguous evidence, recommend review.
rules.incident: Close-out recommended with no review on the trail.
rules.class_reason: Verbatim repeat of the closing sentences at L147 in the same prompt.

rules.summary: If work has not landed, check the description for a plan and a session-fit answer.
rules.class_reason: Plan presence and the session-fit literal are already regex-detected in lib/recommendation-facts.js:50.

rules.summary: Never re-recommend research/plan when its deliverable already exists; route a settled plan onward.
rules.incident: A fully planned ticket got another plan instead of breakdown.
rules.class_reason: Plan block plus session-fit literal with no children is detectable; recommendation-facts.js already parses session-fit.

rules.summary: Recommend plan-review when a plan exists, the gate (a)-(d) or 'plan-review due: yes' holds, and no verdict yet.
rules.class_reason: Keys on the recorded 'plan-review due' literal and verdict absence; checkable at the recommend seam, criteria (b)-(d) aside.

rules.summary: On plan-review Approve route by session-fit; never re-emit plan-review; Approve is never close-out evidence.
rules.class_reason: Verdict plus session-fit literal to next kind is a lookup table.

rules.summary: A plan saying 'needs multiple sessions' routes to breakdown.
rules.class_reason: The session-fit literal is already parsed (lib/recommendation-facts.js:50); routing on it is a table lookup.

rules.summary: Recommend implementation only with a plan or in-hand small scope, prep done, no blockers, clear requirements.
rules.class_reason: Composite readiness judgement about scope and clarity.

rules.summary: On a node, first decide node-level work (breakdown, close, triage) before deferring to a child.
rules.incident: Recommender descended into finished children instead of closing the parent.
rules.class_reason: Node-vs-descend is judgement; the no-defer-into-finished-child bullet is already backstopped by lib/recommend-recurse.js:186.

rules.summary: The generated prompt references the task; do not restate its description or comment thread.
rules.class_reason: Restated in full by the Context section (L287) of the same prompt.

rules.summary: With featureBranches on: create a feature branch from main.
rules.class_reason: Toggle-gated block superseded by the always-on branch/PR rule in Implementation clause (6) (LIN-523).

rules.summary: With self-review on: verify correctness against task requirements before committing.
rules.class_reason: Toggle-gated duplicate of formatSelfReview; the separate review stage covers it.

rules.summary: With self-review on: confirm code style matches the codebase.
rules.class_reason: Toggle-gated duplicate of formatSelfReview and the review checklist.

rules.summary: With CI/CD check on: do not mark Done until checks pass or the no-CI substitute is clean.
rules.class_reason: Superseded: implementation never marks Done; close-out owns Done and the CI gate (LIN-550, LIN-1455).

rules.summary: With PR review on: only mark Done after approval and merge.
rules.class_reason: Superseded by close-out owning merge and the Done transition (LIN-550).

rules.summary: Blocked prompts must front-load a status check on blocking dependencies.
rules.class_reason: Blocker resolution is a relation/state lookup; duplicates Step 2's blocked check (L183).

rules.summary: Triage prompts must confirm the task is in the correct project and move it if mis-filed.
rules.incident: Triage left tasks unassigned or in the wrong project.
rules.class_reason: Having a project is checkable; choosing the right one for the scope is judgement.

rules.summary: Bug prompts must include a class check once root cause is known; keep the fix minimal.
rules.incident: Bug fixes patched one witness and missed sibling instances.
rules.signature: isolated, or one of a class
rules.class_reason: Finding siblings of a failure pattern is judgement.

rules.summary: Bug prompts must search wider than nearby code: prior investigations and diverging episodes.
rules.incident: Investigations ignored prior diverging episodes of the same subsystem.
rules.class_reason: Where to look for prior art is judgement; restated in the Research-prompts rule.

rules.summary: Research prompts must require an Audit the Layers pass: enumerate layers, brief each with cited sources.
rules.incident: Research missed an unnamed layer (LIN-735/LIN-295/LIN-579).
rules.class_reason: Exhaustive layer enumeration is judgement; already scale-gated by the small-change clause.

rules.summary: A second representation of already-modelled data makes the Surface Assessment 'refactor required'.
rules.incident: Local additions quietly duplicated an existing model.
rules.class_reason: Recognising a duplicate model needs design judgement.

rules.summary: Plan prompts must check whether requirements share a code path, state or interface and document interactions.
rules.class_reason: Identifying cross-cutting interactions is design judgement.

rules.summary: Plan prompts must carry Strategy Framing (cost-of-doing vs not-doing, named gap) before Scope Assessment.
rules.incident: Plans rationalised the cheap default after the fact.
rules.class_reason: Block presence and order are checkable, but scoring strategies is judgement.

rules.summary: A plan claiming a class for the first time must name it and its bound, ideally a reproducible query.
rules.incident: Four tickets burned 4+ sessions each at enumeration with zero commits.
rules.class_reason: How to bound a class is judgement; LIN-1871 revises LIN-1873.

rules.summary: Do not manufacture a query or checklist to fill the slot; an honest 'no sweep' beats a false bound.
rules.class_reason: Anti-gaming calibration of the class rule; not mechanically checkable.

rules.summary: Plan prompts must record 'plan-review due: yes/no' naming which criteria (a)-(d) fired.
rules.class_reason: The literal and the named criteria are lint-checkable at the description-write seam.

rules.summary: A plan revision replaces the prior plan section, keeping only a short changelog line.
rules.incident: Plan revisions were appended, stacking superseded plans in the description.
rules.class_reason: 'Exactly one plan block in the description' is countable at the description-write seam.

rules.summary: Breakdown prompts must check the ticket's own comment trail for a plan-review Approve first.
rules.incident: Breakdown read the grandparent's rendered Parent Task section for the Approve.
rules.class_reason: Whether this ticket has an Approve plan-review verdict is a dispatch-history lookup.

rules.summary: Plan-review verifies the plan's own claims; it must not redesign or add requirements.
rules.class_reason: Distinguishing a finding from a preference is judgement.

rules.summary: A verifier disputing a bound must argue about the bound, proposing and running an alternative.
rules.incident: Verifiers discovered members one at a time and plan-review looped.
rules.class_reason: How to argue a bound is judgement.

rules.summary: Plan-review check 3: re-run git log on plan files; commit constraints must appear in the plan.
rules.class_reason: Running git log is mechanical; judging whether constraints are reflected is not.

rules.summary: Plan-review check 6: a prerequisite-refactor subtask must name its in-task consumer, and vice versa.
rules.class_reason: Necessity of a refactor is design judgement.

rules.summary: A plan surviving all seven checks gets one line and an immediate handoff; don't manufacture doubt.
rules.class_reason: Calibration against over-flagging; nothing mechanical to check.

rules.summary: Implementation prompts must embed cross-cutting concerns in the relevant step, not a separate section.
rules.class_reason: Placement of concerns in steps is judgement about the plan's content.

rules.summary: Implementation lands on a feature branch PR with CI established once (or substitute); merging is not this step.
rules.incident: A Monitor armed on nonexistent CI checks stalled 195 minutes (LIN-1358).
rules.class_reason: Branch not main, PR open and CI rollup state are queryable via gh; a completion check could verify them.

rules.summary: Implementation prompts must gate blockers on Principle 0 and carry the Principle 0 test verbatim.
rules.class_reason: Restated nearly verbatim in the Blocked and Plan rules of the same prompt and in formatIfBlocked.

rules.summary: Review prompts must cross-reference plan concerns against implementation steps; unaddressed ones are top priority.
rules.class_reason: Gap analysis between plan and implementation is judgement.

rules.summary: Review prompts must assess test level; require e2e/integration where appropriate, not a fixed rule.
rules.incident: Changes shipped with only low-level mocked tests.
rules.class_reason: Right test level is judgement by the rule's own wording.

rules.summary: Review marks every class instance and ledger item inside or outside the ticket's bounded classes.
rules.incident: Inside-scope findings were discharged by filing tickets instead of doing them.
rules.class_reason: Mark presence is checkable but classification is judgement; LIN-2825 amends LIN-1871 and the LIN-550 ledger.

rules.summary: Review must write a '### What CI Did Not Prove' ledger, each item marked and dischargeable, proportional to risk.
rules.incident: Review closed work whose un-CI-provable claims were never checked.
rules.class_reason: Section presence is a heading check; lib/follow-on-ratio.js:161 already regex-detects it but only measures.

rules.summary: Keep the ledger distinct from the class check; say 'ledger empty' when CI covers everything.
rules.class_reason: Breadth-vs-depth distinction is judgement.

rules.summary: Conditional Approve only if close-out can discharge every item within its trivial bound; else Request Changes.
rules.incident: Conditional Approves handed close-out work needing new tests or code.
rules.signature: Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger
rules.class_reason: Per-item fit to close-out's bound is judgement; amendment chain LIN-3056 amends LIN-3033 amends LIN-550.

rules.summary: Landed work with red CI or a hidden blocker: file a blocks ticket, name it next, never loop review.
rules.class_reason: Recognising a hidden blocker is judgement; overlaps Step 0/Step 3 routing text.

rules.summary: Close-out may author a change only when review named its exact content and it is trivially small.
rules.incident: Close-out authored substantive unreviewed changes before merging.
rules.class_reason: Quoted-text match plus 2-file/3-hunk bound is a diff-stat check at the merge seam.

rules.summary: Outside items discharge by a self-contained follow-up ticket; any item by a human naming the precondition.
rules.class_reason: Whether a ticket stands on its own terms is judgement.

rules.summary: Close-out gates on a recorded review Approve plus discharged/empty ledger; that is authorization, no fresh go-ahead.
rules.incident: Close-out blocked on a missing ledger heading despite a recorded Approve.
rules.class_reason: Presence of a review-kind Approve is recoverable from dispatch history; a merge-seam refusal could enforce it once.

rules.summary: After all-clear: merge, verify on landed commit, set Done, summarize, archive then prune, file follow-ups.
rules.incident: Tasks held open for separate verification passes.
rules.class_reason: Merge, Done state, summary and snapshot existence are verifiable post-conditions.

rules.summary: Only outside-scope items may be filed; a close-out-raised 'do it here' ruling is never review-named.
rules.incident: Close-out filed inside-scope items as follow-ups instead of doing them.
rules.class_reason: Inside/outside classification is judgement; LIN-3006 amends LIN-2825.

rules.summary: Every filed follow-up carries a risk-derived priorityLevel and a catalog type label, best-effort.
rules.incident: Follow-ups were filed at provider-default priority with no type label.
rules.class_reason: Priority and label presence on a created issue is a field check at the issue-create seam.

rules.summary: Retrospective-audit must not re-verify overall correctness or re-run the suite; scope to what CI cannot see.
rules.class_reason: Scoping an audit to what CI cannot see is judgement.

rules.summary: Retrospective-audit checks ownership orphans: hazards two sibling tickets each defer to the other.
rules.class_reason: Detecting mutual deferral across tickets needs reading both records.

rules.summary: Block on inability to proceed, not missing checkboxes; simple tasks need simple validation.
rules.class_reason: Calibration principle; no mechanical form.

rules.summary: Follow the decision tree above in order.
rules.class_reason: Restates L130 ('Follow this decision tree IN ORDER') in the same prompt.

rules.summary: The action must be exactly one name, verbatim, from the vocabulary list, bold markers kept.
rules.incident: Response-format directives leaked into output; off-list names fell to 'custom'.
rules.class_reason: deriveDispatchKind silently maps unknown names to `custom`; an enum check with retry would replace the prose.

rules.summary: Fly the ratified legs via child autopilots; do not re-plan the passage or second-guess a ratified leg's shape.
rules.class_reason: Scope-of-authority disposition; no check can tell re-planning from legitimate judgement.

rules.summary: Anchors are related relations only, never blocks/blocked-by; leg-to-anchor mapping lives only in description text.
rules.class_reason: Filtering relations by type and parsing leg anchor lines is deterministic; the kickoff generator could compute the anchor set.

rules.summary: GET /brief is orientation only; it drops making-port criteria and budget, so never source leg fields from it.
rules.incident: Brief verified to drop every leg's making-port criteria and budget split.
rules.class_reason: Source-hierarchy instruction; restated in Hard rules (L227) and the preamble, so one copy could go.

rules.summary: Launched runs have a dispatch row; hand-pasted runs don't, and must never fabricate a sessionId.
rules.incident: Format-valid but unreal sessionId is accepted and resolves to nothing.
rules.class_reason: The dispatch seam accepts unreal sessionIds; refusing an id with no matching dispatch row would enforce it once.

rules.summary: For ordered, dependency-linked anchors, dispatch a lane child; not for genuinely independent anchors.
rules.class_reason: Judging whether anchor order is load-bearing is judgement.

rules.summary: State budget accounting as asymmetric by leg shape: goal-only legs uncounted, single-anchor legs count one.
rules.class_reason: Which child dispatches counted is derivable from rows (issueIdentifier present); a report could print it instead of the agent reciting.

rules.summary: Don't set your own maxTasks; read it from your dispatch row and report null as undeclared.
rules.incident: Runner reported ratified pool as enforced when launcher never passed maxTasks.
rules.class_reason: Reading a field off the dispatch row and printing it is mechanical; the landing report could be generated.

rules.summary: Group list rows by sessionId client-side; verify stamping by reading the field, never assuming absence.
rules.incident: Misread of an unchecked field as absent/null.
rules.class_reason: Epistemic discipline; tests pin the code field set (contract-drift test :94), not this prose.

rules.summary: Honor each leg's Wind down if triggers, citing trigger text verbatim from the leg block.
rules.class_reason: Verbatim citation is a substring check against the leg block, checkable on the wind-down comment.

rules.summary: On 409 DUPLICATE_DISPATCH adopt the refusal's id and watch it; don't treat as failure or re-dispatch.
rules.class_reason: The server already refuses the duplicate and returns the live id; also restated in autopilot-kickoff and pinned by count (contract-drift test :152).

rules.summary: Hard rule: a malformed leg block gets a BLOCKED park naming the deviation, never a best-effort guess.
rules.class_reason: Verbatim restatement of Step 2 in the same prompt; the leg-block shape is itself parseable (convert Step 2 instead).

rules.summary: Hard rule: every plan revision, wind-down, and deviation is its own comment immediately, not batched.
rules.class_reason: Restates Step 5 of the same prompt nearly verbatim.

rules.summary: Act as verifier only: never redesign, add requirements, or become a second planner.
rules.class_reason: Deciding what counts as redesign versus a finding is judgement.

rules.summary: Read the plan plus the research it came from; a claim the plan never makes is itself a finding.
rules.class_reason: Judgement about which claims a plan should have made.

rules.summary: Work all seven checks in order, reproducing each result yourself rather than trusting the plan.
rules.class_reason: Independent re-derivation is judgement; only the check order is pinned.

rules.summary: Check 1: re-derive each class bound; name any missed class and all its members; missed class = Request Changes.
rules.incident: Four tickets burned 4+ sessions each finding members one at a time
rules.class_reason: LIN-1871 revises LIN-1873; bounding a class is reasoning a check cannot do.

rules.summary: If you dispute a bound, argue the bound itself: propose the query or reasoning and show its output.
rules.incident: Four tickets each burned 4+ sessions with zero commits at this step
rules.class_reason: Amendment to check 1 (LIN-1871); argumentative judgement.

rules.summary: A class declared un-sweepable passes if the reason and alternative bound are sound; demand a sweep only with a named query.
rules.class_reason: Judging whether a reason is sound; patch on check 1 (LIN-1873, kept by LIN-1871).

rules.summary: Check 2: a routed-around contract gap must be named by ticket identifier or explicit "none identified".
rules.class_reason: Presence of a ticket id or "none identified" in the plan's Strategy Framing is lintable.

rules.summary: Check 3: re-run git log -15 on plan files; constraints from repeated commits must appear in the plan.
rules.class_reason: The git log could be precomputed, but judging whether constraints are covered is judgement.

rules.summary: Check 4: a "fits one session" answer beside specific nameable catches is a contradiction to flag.
rules.class_reason: Weighing whether catches are specific is judgement.

rules.summary: Check 5: flag any loosened validation, contract or guard lacking a named re-tightening follow-up as Request Changes.
rules.class_reason: Recognising a loosening is judgement.

rules.summary: Check 6: a prerequisite-refactor subtask must name its in-task consumer line; a necessary refactor must not be absorbed.
rules.class_reason: Necessity judgement; the consumer-line citation part is lintable.

rules.summary: Check 7: confirm each inherited data source is authoritative; a lossy source carrying load-bearing data is Request Changes.
rules.class_reason: Judging authority and load-bearing data is judgement.

rules.summary: End with an explicit Approve / Request Changes / Needs Discussion verdict, one-line justification, citing the producing check.
rules.class_reason: Verdict vocabulary is parseable; a comment parser could require exactly one verdict. plan-review-round-trips.js only measures it.

rules.summary: A clean plan gets one line "claims verified; proceed to implementation"; do not manufacture doubt.
rules.class_reason: Anti-overreach disposition, not checkable.

rules.summary: Plan-review is write-only: never edit the plan, implement, or file follow-ups; hand back to plan or implementation.
rules.class_reason: A plan-review-kind token could refuse description writes and issue creation; today read-only is prose convention.

rules.summary: Record findings and verdict in a comment headed "### Plan Review Verdict"; leave the plan untouched.
rules.class_reason: Header presence is lintable, but LIN-810 forbids keying a gate on it: a warning lint, not a block.

rules.summary: Workflow step 1: set the issue status to In Progress in the tracker if not already.
rules.class_reason: A status transition; the dispatch seam could set In Progress deterministically instead of reciting it in every write-shaped template.

rules.summary: The plan must list files to modify, key changes per file, risks/edge cases, and testing approach.
rules.class_reason: Content of the plan is judgement; presence of headings is checkable but the substance is not.

rules.summary: Before drafting, check comments for a prior plan-review verdict; if none, plan normally.
rules.incident: Second plan generated blind to plan-review findings; one-cycle bound unsatisfiable.
rules.class_reason: Whether a prior verdict comment exists is a lookup the prompt generator could do and inject, rather than asking the agent to search.

rules.summary: Record in the description a short changelog line naming which plan-review findings the revision addresses.
rules.incident: Next plan-review had to re-derive revision against verdict from scratch.
rules.class_reason: Presence of a revision changelog line after a Request Changes verdict is a mechanically checkable description field.

rules.summary: Name any routed-around contract gap with a ticket identifier or explicit 'none identified'.
rules.incident: Cheap default strategies silently routed around tracked contract gaps.
rules.class_reason: A ticket-id-or-'none identified' field in the Strategy Framing block is a presence/format check; plan-review check 2 re-verifies it by hand.

rules.summary: The chosen strategy feeds Scope Assessment; session-fit answers against it, not the cheapest default.
rules.incident: Post-hoc justification of the cheap default strategy.
rules.class_reason: Ordering is pinned by a test (prompt-templates.test.js:656) but answering against the chosen strategy is reasoning quality.

rules.summary: List the surfaces the plan touches; merge surfaces sharing dependencies and failure modes, else separate.
rules.incident: CRUD tasks over-sent to implementation; executor dropped per-operation edges.
rules.class_reason: Deciding what counts as one surface is design judgement.

rules.summary: A class with no possible sweep (new-code destinations, production-data populations) may be declared so, with its shape.
rules.incident: Plans forced to fabricate sweeps for un-sweepable classes.
rules.class_reason: Whether members lie outside the source tree is judgement; LIN-1873 amends the LIN-1871 cited-sweep rule.

rules.summary: For each surface note two or three edges that are easiest to miss.
rules.incident: Executor completed happy path, silently dropping edge cases per operation.
rules.class_reason: Identifying easy-to-miss edges is model judgement; a count check would only check form.

rules.summary: Write the session-fit answer in the description as literally 'fits one session' or 'needs multiple sessions'.
rules.incident: Topology labels mis-routed small multi-step tasks to breakdown.
rules.class_reason: Literal phrase is already parsed by lib/recommendation-facts.js:50; a post-plan check could refuse a plan lacking it.

rules.summary: None of (a)-(d) firing is common; do not volunteer plan-review for a plan meeting no criterion.
rules.incident: Plan-review gate must not tax plans that do not need it.
rules.class_reason: Criteria (a)-(d) are mostly checkable fields (session-fit phrase, gap id); the router could compute plan-review-due instead of the agent.

rules.summary: Workflow step 1: set the issue status to In Progress in the tracker if not already.
rules.class_reason: A status transition the dispatch seam could perform deterministically instead of reciting per template.

rules.summary: When comments exist, review prior research on the task and build on existing findings.
rules.class_reason: Already rendered only when comments exist; weighing prior findings is judgement.

rules.summary: Confirm a metric actually tracks the real outcome before optimizing against it; validate or replace it.
rules.incident: Research optimized against measurements that read green while outcome was wrong.
rules.class_reason: Whether a signal tracks the outcome is irreducible analytical judgement.

rules.summary: Audit the Layers applies only to shared/multi-surface work; small single-surface changes record file and fix.
rules.class_reason: Restates formatScaleToTask, inlined ~25 lines earlier in the same research prompt; one scale-down gate would do.

rules.summary: Brief each layer from actual code/docs/history, cite file:line or commit per claim; derive per-layer axes.
rules.incident: A layer never looked for broke (LIN-735/LIN-295/LIN-579 gaps).
rules.class_reason: Deciding what each layer must hold true against is judgement; citation presence is checkable but not their truth.

rules.summary: Name each class the task touches, say how it was bounded, and list every member found.
rules.incident: Four tickets each burned 4+ sessions discovering members one at a time.
rules.class_reason: Bounding a class is reasoning; LIN-1871 revises LIN-1873 and moves the rule upstream from plan to research.

rules.summary: End research with an explicit Surface Assessment asking whether the feature's shape demands structural change.
rules.incident: Refactor recommendations never surfaced to the plan step on the handwritten path.
rules.class_reason: Presence of a 'Surface Assessment: [...]' line with one of three verdicts is a parseable format check.

rules.summary: Who-pays test: classify each touched consumer as beneficiary or bystander, citing each bystander's new tax.
rules.incident: Refactors taxed bystander consumers for one feature's need.
rules.class_reason: Cost/benefit weighing of a refactor across consumers is design judgement.

rules.summary: Comment output: full notes with per-layer audit, class list, exploration process, and Surface Assessment.
rules.incident: Plan could not read a Surface Assessment left only in the description.
rules.class_reason: Presence of the named sections in the research comment is mechanically checkable at completion.

rules.summary: Verify against requirements; do not add new requirements.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Check recorded scope matches what changed; flag plan overrun or staleness as a finding rather than pressing on.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Run git log -30 on modified files; verify the change does not reintroduce a previously fixed bug.
rules.incident: Local fixes regressed previously fixed behaviour
rules.class_reason: The log could be precomputed; spotting a reintroduced bug is judgement.

rules.summary: Where a recent commit fixed the same behaviour, read it and confirm the fix is intact.
rules.incident: Local fixes regressed previously fixed behaviour
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Verify the change does not re-apply anything a recent commit reverted.
rules.incident: Local fixes regressed previously fixed behaviour
rules.class_reason: Detecting re-applied reverted hunks is possible but brittle; judgement today.

rules.summary: Cross-reference each cross-cutting concern and acceptance criterion against the implementation steps followed.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Treat plan requirements not addressed by any implementation step as highest-priority gaps.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Focus attention on those gaps rather than re-verifying completed work.
rules.class_reason: Attention guidance.

rules.summary: Check whether the change is one of a class; name the class and mark unhandled siblings inside/outside, or state isolated.
rules.incident: Narrow task done in isolation; parent then hit the next sibling
rules.class_reason: Finding siblings is judgement.

rules.summary: Mark every unhandled instance and ledger item inside/outside the bounded classes; inside is own scope, never filed.
rules.incident: Inside-scope work was discharged by filing follow-up tickets
rules.class_reason: LIN-3006 amends LIN-2825; class membership by kind is judgement.

rules.summary: If a ruling is raised, inside items offer only "do it here" or "drop"; "file" only for outside items.
rules.class_reason: If rulings carried the inside/outside mark as a field, the rulings API could refuse a "file" option for inside items.

rules.summary: Inside/outside marking is orthogonal to risk lanes; unprovable inside items still route through monitor/rollback lanes.
rules.class_reason: Patch reconciling LIN-2825 with LIN-898/1579 lanes; exists only because two rule chains overlap.

rules.summary: Before filing an outside item, search relations and search for an existing ticket; link it instead of refiling.
rules.class_reason: Matching "same file and finding" is judgement; the search itself is mechanical.

rules.summary: Before raising a DECISION, query rulings incl. resolved; never re-raise a finding an existing row covers.
rules.class_reason: The rulings route already holds the data (includeResolved); it could refuse a duplicate DECISION for the same anchor.

rules.summary: For cross-module or user-facing behaviour, verify e2e/integration tests exist where appropriate.
rules.class_reason: Test-level appropriateness is judgement.

rules.summary: Flag changes that add only low-level tests for behaviour needing end-to-end coverage.
rules.class_reason: Judgement; overlaps the checklist item.

rules.summary: Choose the test level from the change itself; do not enforce a fixed rule.
rules.class_reason: Explicitly a judgement instruction.

rules.summary: Mutation-check load-bearing tests: remove each claimed code path, confirm red, revert, report the mutation.
rules.incident: Tests stayed green with their claimed code path never wired in
rules.class_reason: A mutation-testing run over changed lines in CI checks this mechanically, once, instead of per-review prose.

rules.summary: Checklist: implementation matches task requirements.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Checklist: tests cover new/changed behaviour.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Checklist: tests exist at the appropriate level (e2e/integration where needed).
rules.class_reason: Restates the Test Quality Check bullets earlier in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Checklist: tests verify no unintended side effects; state left clean.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Checklist: interactions between features sharing a code path are tested.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Checklist: load-bearing new/changed tests were mutation-checked, not merely inspected.
rules.class_reason: Restates the mutation-check bullet earlier in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Checklist: no security vulnerabilities introduced.
rules.class_reason: Security review sensible for auth/credential/data surfaces; recited on every review including docs-only.

rules.summary: Checklist: error handling is appropriate.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Checklist: code style consistent with the codebase.
rules.class_reason: A linter/formatter in CI checks style mechanically.

rules.summary: Checklist: no performance regressions.
rules.class_reason: No benchmark exists; judgement.

rules.summary: Checklist: CI passes on the PR, or CI is absent and the substitute run is recorded.
rules.class_reason: Restates the CI-gate section and hand-off precondition in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Checklist: no regressions introduced.
rules.class_reason: Restates the Regression Check section in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Checklist: class check answered (isolated, or class named with unhandled instances).
rules.class_reason: Restates the class-check section in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Checklist: code is ready for production.
rules.class_reason: Adds no criterion beyond the verdict it precedes.

rules.summary: For visual or behavioural changes, verify the result directly rather than relying on tests alone.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: If a spec/mockup attachment exists, view it and the result side-by-side before judging fidelity.
rules.class_reason: Perception judgement; renders only with attachments.

rules.summary: Flag anything the agent cannot verify for human testing, with specific check instructions.
rules.class_reason: Judgement.

rules.summary: Write the "What CI Did Not Prove" ledger: every unexercised claim, marked inside/outside with its discharge route.
rules.incident: Irreversible finish had no owner or gate
rules.class_reason: Enumerating unproven claims is judgement; follow-on-ratio.js only measures ledger presence.

rules.summary: Keep the ledger (verification depth) distinct from the class check (breadth).
rules.class_reason: Conceptual guidance.

rules.summary: Unprovable claims become hard gate items only on runtime, data, security or external-contract changes.
rules.incident: Prompt-wording change required human sign-off for unprovable claims
rules.class_reason: Already a risk-tiering rule; judging the surface is judgement.

rules.summary: Unprovable-in-principle claim: name a firing monitor and write why nothing short of production proves it.
rules.incident: 31 of 50 ticket-as-monitor discharges were never worked
rules.class_reason: LIN-2917 amends LIN-1579 amends LIN-898; the justification line itself is lintable.

rules.summary: Low-risk reversible change: name the rollback commit or flag; data, security, contract surfaces excluded.
rules.class_reason: Reversibility is judgement; LIN-1579 amends LIN-898.

rules.summary: Key the lane on risk surface and what you can name, never size or file type; the ledger never shrinks.
rules.class_reason: Judgement; restates the floors of the two lanes above.

rules.summary: If CI covers everything, say "CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty"; don't manufacture doubt.
rules.signature: CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty
rules.class_reason: Anti-overreach disposition.

rules.summary: With CI absent, record the substitute run's known limits as ledger items.
rules.incident: LIN-1358: agent wedged 195 minutes waiting on nonexistent CI
rules.class_reason: Restates formatCiGateCheck's residue sentence, inlined just below in the same prompt.

rules.summary: Conclude with an explicit Approve / Request Changes / Needs Discussion verdict and one-line justification.
rules.class_reason: Verdict vocabulary is parseable at the comment seam.

rules.summary: A non-empty ledger requires "Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger", never bare Approve.
rules.signature: Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger
rules.class_reason: Ledger non-empty implies conditional wording: a parser can check the pair.

rules.summary: Conditional Approve only if close-out can discharge every item within its trivial bound; else Request Changes.
rules.incident: Inside items needing new tests got conditional Approves
rules.class_reason: LIN-3056 amends LIN-550 via LIN-3033; judging required authoring is judgement.

rules.summary: Review does not merge, mark Done, or file close-out follow-ups.
rules.class_reason: Stated three times in this prompt (Verdict, Hand Off, Completion).

rules.summary: Review is write-only: deliverable is ledger plus verdict; merge, Done and follow-ups belong to close-out.
rules.incident: Irreversible finish had no owner or gate
rules.class_reason: The proxy could refuse a Done transition from a review-kind dispatch; merge via gh is outside Harbour.

rules.summary: Do not try to confirm a merge that has not happened yet.
rules.incident: Review demanded proof of a merge that happens after it
rules.class_reason: Patch left from LIN-523/550 when review owned the merge; implied by write-only.

rules.summary: Before Approve confirm CI green (or substitute independently re-run) and all checks satisfied; red CI = Request Changes.
rules.class_reason: PR check state is queryable; an Approve comment on a red head could be refused or flagged.

rules.summary: On Approve hand off to close-out; review's job ends at verdict plus ledger comment.
rules.class_reason: Describes close-out's duties, restated in close-out itself; review side duplicates write-only.

rules.summary: When handing an edit to close-out, quote the exact change; if you cannot, or it is not trivial, Request Changes.
rules.incident: Close-out merged content review never saw
rules.class_reason: Exactness partly lintable ("e.g." detection); triviality is judgement.

rules.summary: Cannot-close branch (red CI or hidden blocker): do not loop into another review or hand to close-out.
rules.class_reason: Judgement of a blocker.

rules.summary: Create or link the surfaced work as a blocks relation on the current task.
rules.class_reason: Relation creation is an action; deciding blocker scope is judgement.

rules.summary: Name the blocker's kind (bug/plan/implementation) as next action, never another review.
rules.incident: A blocks relation does not make the engine descend
rules.class_reason: Routing judgement.

rules.summary: Leave the task open with Request Changes/Needs Discussion until the blocker resolves and CI is green.
rules.class_reason: Sequencing guidance.

rules.summary: Keep a review-time closure blocker distinct from a plan-phase prerequisite-refactor subtask.
rules.class_reason: Conceptual distinction.

rules.summary: Summary comment must hold ledger, verdict and CI state; never mark Done or merge.
rules.class_reason: Comment must contain three parseable parts; a lint at comment-write could check.
